rules: Use this library for formulas with fractions, exponents, indices, roots, Greek letters, functions, grouped terms, or worked numeric examples.
Simple axis labels and single-symbol parameter labels may remain native SVG text.
Do not hand-compose complex formulas with SVG text/tspan unless the formula renderer cannot express the notation.
Formula SVGs are assets and may be embedded into scene SVGs with a data-formula-asset attribute.
Rendered formula SVGs used by a specific slide must be stored under that slide folder, for example rebuild-proposals/svg/<module_id>/slide_###/formulas/.
